name: Shinnyuu Shain Saori ~Iinari Pet Ikusei Chikan Kenshuu~
original_name: 新入社員 沙織 ～いいなりペット育成痴漢研修～
source:
Monday morning. The start of gloom. Swayed by the crowded train, heading to the company to become just another cog in the machine. The protagonist, Yaginuma Kouhei, was no exception. Standing in line, waiting for the train. He looked ahead and saw a fresh-faced woman who was just his type. From the looks of it, a new employee.

"First impressions are crucial, first impressions are crucial..."

She nodded slightly to herself as if trying to reassure herself. Then she unfolded a piece of paper she had been holding. Peeking over, he saw what looked like an introductory speech. That's how he learned her name. Hirasaka Saori - Saori-chan, huh. Of course, the first day is important. But if you're that nervous, you're bound to mess up. Alright, I'll help ease your nerves, Saori-chan...

[Translated from the [url=https://www.torpedo-game.com/trp_007.html]official site[/url]]
